_about: The fix loop (lib/fix-loop.ts) on an existing workspace: the crash fuzzer is a probe, not a gate; one reviewer session per clean probe (wrap-up nudge + one continuation); at most 3 findings per fix session, 2 fix attempts per round, 4 rounds. Session limits as in the 2026-09-24/25 rotation runs (10 turns, 15 minutes, bash + edit for coding).
